affectedPublicSurfaces: STOP REASONS — the wire vocabulary a client counts end states on. All EIGHT causes must be DISTINCT, non-failing and separately countable: `goal_met`, `expired_stock_remaining`, `expired_goal_met`, `seller_modified`, `already_in_promotion`, `nothing_sellable`, `no_safe_discount`, `declined`. Verified 2026-09-08: `StopReason` (`services/agent/status.py:100-158`) holds SIXTEEN members — `final_response`, `confirmation_declined`, `paused_for_confirmation`, `cancelled_by_seller`, `confirmation_expired`, `confirmation_diverged`, `prompt_version_unrecoverable`, `iteration_cap_exceeded`, `wall_clock_timeout`, `tool_error_unrecoverable`, `llm_error`, `concurrency_conflict`, `output_validation_failed`, `worker_lost`, `concluded_without_changes`, `required_steps_unfulfilled` — and NONE of the eight is among them; the nearest is `CONFIRMATION_DECLINED` (:104), which already maps to `COMPLETED` (:163). All eight fit the `String(32)` column budget. This vocabulary is mirrored into `packages/contracts/src/agent-events.ts` and served on `GET /demo/runs` and the SSE stream, so a client with an exhaustive switch sees values it has never seen.

THE COMPLETION COPY — the facts this slice PRODUCES and #1819 RENDERS. A completed Clear Excess run exposes GOAL PROGRESS (`units cleared ÷ units to clear`, unhedged) and DAYS OF SUPPLY BEFORE AND AFTER, plus its named cause. The separation is the requirement: did-the-job facts are UNHEDGED and kept SEPARATE from hedged impact readings (S-NFR-7), and mixing them is how a fact becomes an estimate nobody trusts.

A NEW RUN-FACT SHAPE ALONGSIDE `impact_readings` — NEVER A CHANGE TO ITS KEY. Verified 2026-09-08: `impact_readings` is uniquely keyed `(tool_execution_id, metric, kind)` (`models.py:868-873`, `uq_impact_readings_execution_metric_kind`) with `kind` CHECK-constrained to `('preliminary','final')` (:874-877) — a difference-in-differences table, and nothing else. Bending it to hold a per-run fact would either force a fake `tool_execution_id` or widen a key every existing reader depends on.

`classify_mutation_kinds` SKIPS A DISCOUNT WRITE ENTIRELY, AND THAT STAYS TRUE. Verified 2026-09-08: `workers/impact_reader/classify.py:44-66` keys off exactly four payload probes in fixed order — `payload["price_update"]` (:58), `payload["image_uri"]` or `image_content_base64` (:60), `title` (:62), `description` (:64) — and returns `[]` for anything else. A discount write classifies as nothing and is skipped. CE-NFR-3 calls for a new fact-row shape rather than a new mutation kind, so the classifier is NOT touched here.

NO ROUTE SHAPE CHANGES AND NO EXISTING READING CHANGES. No endpoint is added; `impact_readings` keeps its key, its CHECK and every one of its readers; the only additions are the run facts and the completed end-state vocabulary.

THE CARD'S KPI TIE IS EXPLICITLY UNTOUCHED, named as a surface because it is the one a reviewer will reach for. `KPI_WORKFLOW_KEYS` maps `clear_excess_4` to `inventory_turnover` (`services/scoring/kpi_catalog.py:46`) and `dsi` (`:47`) while ADR-055 d.15's table says AOV. The two layers already disagree, ADR-091 d.6 records the disagreement WITHOUT resolving it, and CE-NFR-3 leaves both exactly as they are. THE TIE STAYS WHATEVER THE SURFACE RENDERS TODAY.

migrationCompatibility.notes: ADDITIVE ONLY — a RUN-FACT SHAPE ALONGSIDE `impact_readings`, NEVER A CHANGE TO ITS KEY. `impact_readings` keeps `uq_impact_readings_execution_metric_kind` on `(tool_execution_id, metric, kind)` (`models.py:868-873`) and its `kind IN ('preliminary','final')` CHECK (:874-877) exactly as they are; nothing about the DiD table moves. The run facts — goal progress, and days of supply before and after — land either as an additive nullable structure on `workflow_runs` or as a small additive fact table, and THE MIGRATION NUMBER AND `down_revision` ARE RESERVED BY META and supplied with the issue. The days-of-supply pair must be able to hold THE NAMED UNDEFINED VALUE for a zero-velocity SKU, so the column cannot be a bare NOT NULL numeric: NULL must not be overloaded to mean both 'not recorded' and 'undefined', or the two become indistinguishable on read. Nothing is dropped, renamed or retyped; no NOT NULL and no backfill; the previous release never names the new shape and keeps reading `workflow_runs` and `impact_readings` unchanged. If the eight stop reasons need the `ck_workflow_runs_stop_reason` CHECK widened and #1707 did NOT already do it, STOP AND REPORT rather than widening it here — the enum and the constraint must move in ONE commit or the parity test finds the drift after the fact. Any new table is tenant-scoped and must be covered by the runtime role's grants from `043_juli_app_role.py` (ADR-085) and by an RLS policy — assert that coverage as `juli_app`, never as the owner. NEVER run `alembic heads`, never read the tip of `backend/src/juli_backend/database/migrations/versions/`, never derive the number from the newest filename. The chain's single head today is `055_juli_app_sync_state_update`, but W6, W8, W9 and the sibling W10 lanes hold unlanded numbers off-tree and this tree already carries two duplicate-numbered pairs (`003_*`, `043_*`) from exactly this mistake.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge. A Clear Excess run records no goal progress and no days-of-supply pair, the eight causes are not distinguishable (none of them exists in `StopReason`'s sixteen members today), and #1819 has no facts to render. `impact_readings` and `classify_mutation_kinds` stay exactly as they are, which they would anyway. Nothing is exposed, nothing is partially applied, no data hazard: this slice writes only its own additive rows and never reaches a vendor.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: Redeploy the previous release FIRST and restart juli-api and juli-celery-worker: the previous code neither writes nor reads the run-fact shape and never emits the eight causes, so it runs correctly against the widened schema and needs NO downgrade. RECORDED FACTS REMAIN READABLE and NO READER OF `impact_readings` IS AFFECTED — the DiD table was never touched, which is the specific property the post-deploy check verifies. Only if the schema must ALSO be reverted, `alembic downgrade -1` drops the additive fact shape, destroying goal-progress and days-of-supply history and nothing else; that downgrade MUST FAIL LOUDLY with a named error, never silently delete or coerce, when any run still carries a fact a shipped surface reads, and it must NEVER narrow `ck_workflow_runs_stop_reason` under live rows holding one of the eight causes. Order: previous code first, downgrade second, so no live process is mid-write against a constraint being narrowed. DRAIN OR REAP EVERY RUN IN `waiting_external` BEFORE any rollback that removes the resume path (#1816/#1817): the previous reaper judges only `(QUEUED, RUNNING)` and `(WAITING_APPROVAL,)` (`reaper.py:400,441`), so a suspended run left behind is inert — it will never resume and never be reaped while its live discount keeps running.

doNotInfer: The migration number and `down_revision` are RESERVED BY META and supplied with the issue. NEVER run `alembic heads`, never read the tip of `backend/src/juli_backend/database/migrations/versions/`, never derive the number from the newest filename. This slice DOES carry a migration, so the reservation is binding.

Do NOT bend `impact_readings` to hold a run fact. Its unique key is `(tool_execution_id, metric, kind)` (`models.py:868-873`) with `kind IN ('preliminary','final')` (:874-877) — a DiD table. Holding a per-run fact there would force a fake `tool_execution_id` or widen a key every existing reader depends on. CE-NFR-3 calls for a NEW FACT-ROW SHAPE ALONGSIDE IT.

Do NOT add a `MutationKind.DISCOUNT` or edit `classify_mutation_kinds`. `workers/impact_reader/classify.py:44-66` keys off four payload probes and returns `[]` for a discount write, which is skipped — and that stays true. A classifier branch here would silently start generating DiD readings for a workflow that must produce facts, not estimates.

Do NOT amend `KPI_WORKFLOW_KEYS` or ADR-055 d.15's table. `clear_excess_4` maps to `inventory_turnover` and `dsi` (`services/scoring/kpi_catalog.py:46-47`) while the ADR table says AOV. The two layers already disagree, ADR-091 d.6 records the disagreement WITHOUT resolving it, CE-NFR-3 leaves both alone, and THE TIE STAYS WHATEVER THE SURFACE RENDERS TODAY. 'Fixing' it here is out of scope and is a card-KPI change in disguise.

Do NOT read revenue. v1 records the facts ONLY; the revenue reading on the cleared SKUs is DEFERRED TO V2 (spec §3 Deferred, PRD Out of Scope). Assert on the metrics actually queried, not on the absence of a call site.
Do NOT hedge the goal-progress fact or file it as an impact reading. Did-the-job facts are UNHEDGED and SEPARATE from hedged readings (S-NFR-7); a fact filed as an estimate is an estimate.

Do NOT collapse the eight causes into one generic 'nothing to do'. That would make eight different facts indistinguishable, which is the option ADR-091 d.7 explicitly rejected — and per S-FR-7 NONE of them is a failure.

Do NOT alias `declined` onto the existing `confirmation_declined`. That member already exists (`status.py:104`) and already maps to `COMPLETED` (:163); reusing it would make two of the eight indistinguishable. Name the eight distinctly and assert a set of size eight.
Do NOT count a run that wrote nothing as a failure, and do NOT give it an impact reading. It is a success with a named cause, counted separately.

Do NOT re-implement `days_of_supply`. Use #1812's helper, asserted by identity — ADR-093's Replenish lane imports the same one, and a second copy of the arithmetic is exactly the defect that slice exists to prevent.
Do NOT store infinity for a zero-velocity SKU, and do NOT overload NULL to mean both 'not recorded' and 'undefined'. The undefined value is NAMED and must survive the round trip through the column.
Do NOT render completion copy. This slice PRODUCES the facts; #1819 renders them, in the ui-ux lane.

Do NOT widen the stop-reason CHECK in isolation. If #1707 did not land the eight causes in BOTH the enum and a migration, stop and report — a four-place version of a five-place change passes tests and breaks the wire.
Do NOT infer a flash sale, a markdown, a base-price write or a stock write. This slice writes only its own additive rows and reaches no vendor.
Do NOT let a model choose a fact. Goal progress and days of supply are computed by a deterministic rule from run state and #1812's helper (S-FR-4).
Do NOT enforce a goal on a timer, do NOT add a second reaper policy, and do NOT ask for a fresh CONFIRM. Nothing in this slice waits, resumes or consents.
Do NOT reach for `Search Activities`. It DOES NOT EXIST at TikTok (resolved 2026-09-05 — `contract-collection.md` A-25, `endpoints.md:509`).
Do NOT open the TikTok corpora catalogs (ADR-051); do NOT touch apps/**, packages/** or ios/** — this epic's doNotLoad list.

Bind every test collaborator to the REAL run object and the REAL accessor, reading a REAL persisted row back. A `**kwargs` double proves routing, and asserting on an in-memory object the test constructed proves the setter and nothing else.
